landing.title: Protein without the diet.
landing.lead: Reaching your protein goal is easier than it looks. With real food, in portions you recognize, without counting calories.

diet.a: No. The app only adds: no forbidden foods, no calories, no daily logging.

numbers.q: Where do the numbers come from?
numbers.a: From reference food composition tables, such as INSA's. Protein is always calculated by the app, never by the AI.

account.a: Yes: you sign in with Google or Apple, in one tap. That way we keep your plan and your recipes on any device. You can export or delete everything whenever you want.

supplements.a: No. The example day uses only real food. Whey is in the catalog, flagged, for those who already use it.

allergies.q: What if I have allergies or don't eat meat?
allergies.a: Tell us at the start. Your day and your recipes never include those foods, and you can change that whenever you want.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Protein Plate is a personal project by Bernardo Paulino. For any question about your data, write to bernardo.sobral7@gmail.com.

account.title: Account
account.body: To use the app, you sign in with Google or Apple. We store your name and your email. Sessions don't store your IP or your browser, and Google and Apple tokens aren't stored (except Apple's, encrypted, so we can disconnect Apple when you delete your account).

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: We store your daily goal, training intensity, meals (including the ones before and after training), type of diet, the foods you like, the equipment and time you have to cook, your day and the recipes you save. We use this to personalize your day and your recipes (performance of the contract).

health.title: Health data
health.body: Your weight and your allergies and intolerances are health data. We only store them with your explicit consent, given at the end of the initial form, and only to calculate your goal and exclude foods. You can withdraw your consent at any time: enter your goal by hand and remove your allergies in your preferences, or delete your account.

ai.title: AI recipes
ai.body: To generate a recipe, we send the AI model (Anthropic) only the names of the chosen foods, the meal, the time, the servings, the equipment and the type of diet. We never send your name, your email, your weight or your allergies (foods with allergens are simply left off the list).

limits.title: Usage limits
limits.body: To prevent abuse, we count the recipes generated per day with a code derived from your account (HMAC with a key that changes every day). The counters are deleted after 2 days.

storage.title: Where the data is stored
storage.body: On Cloudflare (D1 database in the European Union). We don't use third-party analytics or advertising cookies. The person responsible for the service has a protected admin panel to provide support and see aggregate numbers; each person's weight and allergies never appear in that panel.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: In Account you can export all your data (JSON), change your preferences and delete your account at any time. We also keep the last 50 recipes you generated (so you can find them in Recipes), the ones you marked as favorites and the recipe you put in each meal of your day. Deleting your account deletes your profile, preferences, day, saved recipes, history and sessions. Generated recipes have no owner and stay public through their link.

age.title: Age
age.body: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account.

what.title: What it is
what.body: Protein Plate helps you reach your protein goal with real food. It's free and requires an account (Google or Apple).

general.title: General information
general.body: The information is general and doesn't replace a nutritionist or doctor. If you have kidney disease, are pregnant or have another health condition, talk to a professional before increasing your protein.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.body: Nutritional values come from the Portuguese Food Composition Table (TCA) from INSA. Until curation is complete, some values are provisional and are flagged as such.

ai.title: AI-generated recipes
ai.body: Recipes are generated by AI and may contain errors. Protein is calculated by the app from the TCA. Always check allergens, intolerances and cooking times.

fairUse.title: Fair use
fairUse.body: There are daily limits on new recipes. Don't use the app in an automated way or to overload the service.

account.title: Account
account.body: You can delete your account whenever you want. We may suspend accounts used for abuse.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
